NeckTurn.motion: default -90..+90 degrees yaw about Z; configurable in URDFconfig.json

NeckNodUp.motion: default -20..+20 degrees about the Solid U-Joint Y hinge; direction reversed by default so +input raises the face

NeckTiltRight.motion: default -15..+15 degrees about the Solid U-Joint X hinge

EyesHorizontalRight.motion: calibrated Min/Zero/Max: outer Gimbal Ring, Gimbal Spacers, the two top/bottom SCHCSCREW 0.086-56x0.125 pivot screws, and descendant Wollensak Raptar lens assembly rotate about URDF Z; configurable per child servo

EyesVerticalUp.motion: calibrated Min/Zero/Max: Wollensak Raptar lens/iris assembly rotates inside the Gimbal Ring about local URDF Y through the CAD Gimbal Spacer centerline; the two 0.125 in SCHCSCREW pivot screws remain fixed to the Gimbal Ring; configurable per child servo

IrisClose.motion: inner aperture diameter is piecewise-linear: 1.80 in (45.72 mm) at -100, 0.90 in (22.86 mm) at 0/default, and 0.30 in (7.62 mm) at +100; reversal remains configurable

rgbBacking.behavior: fixed-size circle behind the blue iris annulus; RGBCommand changes its material color

FlapsOpen.motion: default -90..+90 degree semantic travel around CAD servo pinions; configurable

FlapTiltUp.motion: default -30..+90 degrees around basket-mounted HS-85 pinions; 0 remains CAD neutral

VentsOpen.motion: default 0..30 degrees on HS-40 drive/fins; configurable

NoseBody.motion: default -45..+45 degrees about ASME B18.8.2 spindle; configurable

NoseBasket.motion: 0 defaults to the minimum/default basket position; 0..100 maps across the configurable mechanical endpoints (default -45..+45 degrees) about [HEAD-E-V2-B-02] Pin

Whip_Antenna_RaiseLower.motion: default 0..250 mm lift; configurable. The derived Whip_Antenna_Fold stays 0 degrees until the ASME B18.8.2 hinge center clears the SimplifiedHead2 top, then ramps to 90 degrees as the lower-linkage flat shoulder reaches that same surface.

LeftEyePop.motion: default 0..89.951 mm forward; input 0 is neutral and 2000 places the 3/8-in Delrin-ball front surface 1 mm behind the eye-tube front; configurable

RightEyePop.motion: default 0..89.951 mm forward; input 0 is neutral and 2000 places the 3/8-in Delrin-ball front surface 1 mm behind the eye-tube front; configurable

geometry.rearCoverPlacement: Broad flat mounting face registered to SimplifiedHead2 native back datum Z=0; remaining cover depth extends behind the head.
geometry.upperFlapLinkage: Upper flap plate, flap-mounted HS-85 servo body, mounting bracket, and their mounting screws rotate together about the open/close servo pinion; the inter-servo Servo Arm/rod/collars remain on the tilt carrier as the stationary horn/linkage side.

urdfConfiguration.location: Configuration folder selected by Config > Set Paths
urdfConfiguration.autoLoad: Embedded URDF calibration is the baseline. If URDFconfig.json is present, it loads automatically as a higher-precedence override; Save Default reloads/applies the exact override file immediately, and external saves are watched and live-reloaded.
urdfConfiguration.semantics: Per physical child servo: minExtent/maxExtent/zeroExtent plus optional reverseOverride. Reverse inherits Config > Servo Configuration when no override is present. FlapsOpen retains independent per-child Min/Max; normal gangs share Min/Max while Zero/Direction remain per child.
